item.subject: maths
item.stem:
The graph shows steps walked (in hundreds) for Arjun and Bina across four weekdays that Zara recorded in order. She is choosing between this line graph and a display with many clustered bars.

Which two claims about this display are correct?

options.A: A line graph with two lines shows how each person's steps change across the days and makes the comparison clear.
options.B: The display is a pie chart of the step totals.
options.C: Ordered times suit a line graph better than many crowded clustered bars for comparing the two series.
options.D: Only the tallest plotted point matters for comparing the two people.
